title: Elimination Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2608.17646v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This monograph develops elimination geometry (EG), a typed, native-loss, audit-oriented framework for studying when locally optimal objects can be realized by a shared deployment rule. Elimination and compression may erase distinctions required by prediction, inference, control, or representation. EG asks which distinctions are lost, whether the induced defect is visible to the declared task, and whether changing information, architecture, action space, or deployment domain can repair it. EG separates local solvability, global realizability, and finite-sample certifiability. It derives native defects from the original objective and distinguishes architecture obstruction from model approximation, generalization, and implementation error. The monograph synthesizes tools from geometry, optimization, information theory, statistics, and machine learning into interfaces for integrability, representation admissibility, resource constraints, obs

translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17646v1 公告类型：新 摘要：本专著发展了消除几何（EG），这是一个类型化、原生损失、面向审计的框架，用于研究局部最优对象何时能通过共享部署规则实现。消除和压缩可能擦除预测、推理、控制或表示所需区分。EG探讨哪些区分被丢失，诱导缺陷是否对声明的任务可见，以及改变信息、架构、行动空间或部署领域是否能修复它。EG分离了局部可解性、全局可实现性和有限样本可认证性。它从原始目标推导原生缺陷，并区分架构障碍与模型近似、泛化和实现误差。该专著将几何、优化、信息论、统计和机器学习工具综合成可积性、表示可接受性、资源约束等接口。
tldr: 消除几何框架系统化分析局部最优解在部署中因消除或压缩导致的信息损失，并区分架构障碍与模型误差，以评估和修复部署缺陷。
en_tdlr: Elimination geometry systematically analyzes information loss from elimination or compression in deploying locally optimal solutions, distinguishing architectural obstruction from model errors to assess and repair deployment defects.
